## CONVERSATION
Concierge: Hi Clint! Welcome to Shiftsmart.
Partner: What shifts are available near me?

## CONCIERGE OUTPUT
Open the Shiftsmart app and go to the Home tab. Look for the white card with the blue "Required to unlock shifts" banner, it's the In-app orientation card. Tap Get started, then Start learning modules. Takes about 45 minutes total and you'll earn $10 when you're done. After that, the Shifts tab shows all the shifts available near you.
